verdict.summary: All recorded facts match the email, the repair quote (total incl. VAT €1,180 for Emma Rousseau's Tesla on policy VER-1007) and the contract; the claim was reported within 5 days, C3 glass breakage is covered in the Schedule, both required documents are provided, no exclusion applies and no playbook referral rule is triggered, so the staged payment of €1,130 after the €50 deductible should be approved.
